annotations.text:
Direction: warm off-white ground (#f5f3f0), petrol accent (#0f6d7a), IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono for every number.
Carried over from the current app: 8px button radii, 12px card radii, the 68px score ring at stroke-width 7, 20px pill chips.
Dark mode is a toggle, not the default.

Two scores, never averaged.
Fit = Jobright, dark panel, ring + Experience / Skills / Industry breakdown.
ATS = ours, petrol chip, only appears once a job has been tailored.
Tailored is local-only and never pushed to Jobright. The other five columns are Jobright's own statuses, so the counts reconcile exactly with the 212 already on their side.
